basis: ForUsAll's own release (PR Newswire, 2018-01-18): it 'secured $21 million in second round financing led by Ribbit Capital', with Nick Shalek, General Partner at Ribbit, quoted; the round's Form D (first sale 2017-11-17, $21,669,992) names Shalek a director. The firm's WordPress held the company's logo (uploads/2015/10/forusall.png), and its listing likely fell in the unarchived 2019-2020 window.

note: ForUsAll, a 401(k) adviser for small and mid-sized businesses, San Francisco (the release dateline; 350 Townsend Street on the Form D). Ribbit led the $21M 'second round financing' announced in January 2018, Foundation Capital joining as the existing investor, which brought total funding to $34M (PR Newswire, 2018-01-18); the company's Form D sequence shows three earlier rounds (2013, 2014, 2016), so the entry reads Growth by the label and by the structural rule. Later Form Ds (2021, $9.6M; 2022, $5.4M) show it operating and raising; no sale or shutdown found, and no valuation at or above $1B.
